best_direction.angle_title: When failing the experiment changed how the student thinks
best_direction.core_claim: This is not about the experiment failing. It is about how the student thought through the failure — what they changed in their method and why that was harder than the original work.
best_direction.why_this_is_the_real_story: Losing the competition is not the story. The essay is about the student who revised their methodology after feedback — not just their attitude after the loss.
best_direction.what_it_reveals_about_the_student: It shows that the student responds to failure by asking what went wrong in the method — not by reframing the outcome.
best_direction.why_it_beats_the_obvious_angle: A resilience essay describes the emotional arc of recovering. This version describes the reasoning inside it — a more precise and less common story.
best_direction.main_risk_if_written_poorly: If the draft centers on winning or losing, the essay becomes predictable and misses the shift in how the student now approaches problems.
best_direction.next_move: Do not start with the competition result. Start with the decision that did not hold up. Write what you changed after feedback, then show how that shift affects how you work now. Build the draft around the shift from outcome obsession to evidence-based adaptation.

alternatives.what_this_angle_would_focus_on: Execution quality and accomplishment evidence in the same experience.
alternatives.why_it_is_weaker: It can show capability, but it underweights internal change and essay-level tension.
alternatives.failure_mode: Can collapse into an activity summary without a deeper interpretive claim.

alternatives.what_this_angle_would_focus_on: How your actions affected other people and community outcomes.
alternatives.why_it_is_weaker: It carries moral seriousness, but the self-revision arc is less sharply evidenced than the winner.
alternatives.failure_mode: Can become broad values prose if the turning moment is not dramatized.

depth_signals.detected_tension: The tension is between what happened and what it actually changed in you.
depth_signals.obvious_but_weaker_angle: Obvious but weaker angle: resilience story with generic bounce-back language.
depth_signals.essay_opportunity: Frame the essay around the shift from outcome obsession to evidence-based adaptation.
